title: Using Occlusion-Based Saliency Maps to Explain an Artificial Intelligence Tool in Lung Cancer Screening: Agreement Between Radiologists, Labels, and Visual Prompts
key_finding: 36 radiologists described, in LDCT reporting vocabulary, regions highlighted by occlusion-based saliency maps on 20 low-dose CT cases (10 benign, 10 malignant); agreement on the main label in 5 of 41 regions (12%).
